🔥 Key Signals This Week (June 10, 2026)

  • Agentic Client War: The race is no longer about foundation models — it's about who owns the "agentic client" through which employees invoke AI actions
  • Snowflake Summit (June 2): Launched CoWork — personal AI work agent for knowledge workers. Plus 26 new Horizon Catalog innovations for AI governance
  • Microsoft Build: Fabric positioned as THE data platform for AI agents. New Azure HorizonDB + GPU-accelerated Fabric Data Warehouse. "Context layer" is the key
  • MCP Goes Mainstream: Microsoft, Google Cloud, Databricks, AND Snowflake all moving toward MCP-enabled enterprise architectures. Anthropic's protocol becoming standard
  • Databricks Data + AI Summit: 30,000+ in-person attendees expected. Agentic AI and data intelligence taking center stage
  • Battle Lines Forming: Microsoft (Work IQ/Fabric IQ) vs Snowflake (Horizon Context/Cortex Sense) vs Databricks (Unity Catalog) vs SAP (Business Data Cloud) vs Salesforce (Data 360)
